sections.title: Introduction to Creative Writing: Poetry and Life Writing
sections.description: An introduction to the craft of poetry and life writing. We will focus on the main tools of poetry, such as sound, image, and enjambment, as well as the forms of life writing, including narrative, description, and personal commentary. To learn more about this course, visit the Creative Writing Program at https://creative.writing.upenn.edu.
